title: Automatic headlights don't turn on at dusk — here's what's actually failing

beats.visualPrompt: Dusk parking lot, static wide shot: two cars parked side by side, one with headlights lit, one completely dark, ambient blue-hour light falling fast. No hands, no face.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles
beats.onScreenText: Your headlights are set to 'auto' — and they're still not turning on?
beats.vo: Headlights on auto, still dark at dusk?

beats.visualPrompt: Macro, rack focus: a dashboard headlight switch dial resting on the 'AUTO' position, soft interior glow, static camera.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles
beats.onScreenText: Before you blame the bulb — 'auto' relies on a light sensor, not the bulb itself.
beats.vo: Auto mode runs off a light sensor, not the bulb.

beats.visualPrompt: Macro on a small sensor housing near the base of the windshield/dash top, shallow depth of field, slow push-in.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles
beats.onScreenText: That sensor (or a stuck relay behind it) is what tells the car it's dark out.
beats.vo: A stuck relay can sit behind that sensor too.

beats.visualPrompt: Interior macro, rack focus from the headlight switch dial turning past 'AUTO' toward 'ON,' static camera, no hand visible — dial framed alone.
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles
beats.onScreenText: Fastest safe check: switch to 'ON' manually. Lights work? It's the sensor, not the bulb.
beats.vo: Flip the switch to ON by hand.

beats.visualPrompt: Wide shot: car exterior at dusk, headlights now lit, engine bay hood open in the background at a shop bay (prop framing only, no hand in frame).
beats.negativePrompt: faces, hands, human figures, on-screen text, logos, watermarks, subtitles
beats.onScreenText: A dead sensor or relay is a quick diagnosis — not a guessing game.
beats.vo: If they light up, that points at the sensor, not bulbs.

beats.visualPrompt: Dusk parking lot, static wide shot: the same two cars parked side by side, both now with headlights lit and throwing pools across the asphalt, ambient blue-hour light falling further.
beats.vo: Worth checking before buying new bulbs.
